title: Add unhandled exception filter + stack trace for STATUS_ILLEGAL_INSTRUCTION
purpose: Capture and log exception codes and a minimal stack trace to diagnose early startup crashes (0xC000001D).

steps.detail: Install SetUnhandledExceptionFilter at App::initialize() entry. On exception, print code (hex) and walk stack via RtlCaptureStackBackTrace; resolve module names via GetModuleFileName.
Wrap createDevice()/CreateDXGIFactory2 with __try/__except or structured try/catch to log stage before crash.
Ensure console attached before installing filter so logs are visible.

acceptance: On crash, console prints Unhandled exception: 0xC000001D and a few stack frames
We can identify if the faulting module is D3D12Core.dll or elsewhere
